Esta competencia está organizada en colaboración con el Programa [+FECSH](https://www.instagram.com/masfecsh_ufro/?hl=es) y el [Centro de Alumnos de Facultad de Ingeniería y Ciencias UFRO](https://www.instagram.com/cee.fica/?hl=es). Por favor leer **ATENTAMENTE** las pestañas[ Preguntas Frecuentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UFROalCubo2026#76904-preguntas-frecuentes) y [Rondas Duales / Dobles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UFROalCubo2026#77013-rondas-duales-dobles) --- **UFRO al Cubo 2026 is here!** After a successful first edition, UFRO returns to the Cube with a more ambitious championship proposal and full of surprises! Don't miss this unmissable event! This competition is organized in collaboration with the [+FECSH](https://www.instagram.com/masfecsh_ufro/?hl=es) Program and the [UFRO Faculty of Engineering and Sciences Student Council](https://www.instagram.com/cee.fica/?hl=es). Please read the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UFROalCubo2026#76904-preguntas-frecuentes) and [Dual/Double Rounds](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UFROalCubo2026#77013-rondas-duales-dobles) tabs **CAREFULLY**.
